meta.disclaimer: DEMO DATASET. Certification mappings are indexed as representative records. Applicability labels describe what this demo index records, not a legal determination. Verify with BIS / the relevant Quality Control Order before use.

certifications.name: BIS Product Certification (ISI Mark, Scheme-I)
certifications.description: Product certification scheme under which a licensed manufacturer may use the Standard Mark (ISI mark) on products conforming to the relevant Indian Standard. Certain products are brought under compulsory certification through Quality Control Orders.

certifications.name: BIS Compulsory Registration Scheme (CRS, Scheme-II)
certifications.description: Registration scheme for electronic and IT goods and certain other products notified by the Government, under which manufacturers register with BIS after testing against the applicable Indian Standard.

certifications.name: BIS Hallmarking
certifications.description: Certification of purity/fineness of precious metal articles, primarily gold and silver jewellery and artefacts.
